title: Fiona — Campus Mental Health Platform
tagline: AI-powered campus social network with real-time chat & passive mental health monitoring (Perplexity Hackathon)
metric: 5K users handled via O(1) hash routing with sub-10ms delivery; moderation cut from ~800ms to <10ms
bullets: Engineered real-time Next.js/Socket.io platform with Redis pub/sub handling 5K users via O(1) hash routing for sub-10ms delivery.
Structured a two-phase scoring worker computing VADER sentiment at send-time, offloading heavy behavioral metrics to a BullMQ queue.
Mitigated alert fatigue using a 7-day OLS regression slope over rolling windows with weighted moving averages for anomaly scores.
Built client-side Hinglish toxicity filtering via a 5-token sliding regex trie, slashing moderation latency from ~800ms (BERT) to sub-10ms.

title: GraphMind — RAG Pipeline for MetaKGP
tagline: Production-grade 5.5K-page RAG search engine with 3-agent Mixture of Experts (DevSoc Hackathon)
metric: 5.5K pages indexed; top-5 semantic search results delivered under 500ms; 35% latency cut under heavy load
bullets: Engineered a 5.5K-page RAG vector search engine with ChromaDB & PostgreSQL, delivering top-5 semantic results under 500ms.
Designed a 3-agent Mixture of Experts (MoE) pipeline featuring consensus verification to ensure traceable, hallucination-free answers.
Accelerated vector retrieval via targeted HNSW index tuning and embedding caching, slashing query latency by 35% under heavy load.
Architected a scalable FastAPI backend with Groq LLM inference and serverless Modal embeddings for campus-wide Q&A.

title: TypeBolt — Full-Stack Typing Speed Platform
tagline: Full-stack typing performance web platform with containerized Docker environments & real-time analytics
metric: Dashboard query latency slashed by 90% (150ms to <15ms); leaderboard retrieval accelerated by 85%
bullets: Built a full-stack typing platform using React, Node.js, and Docker Compose for consistent, reproducible environments.
Reduced user dashboard aggregate query latency by 90% (150ms to under 15ms) using Redis caching with TTL-based invalidation.
Accelerated paginated leaderboard retrieval by 85% using compound MongoDB indexes, eradicating heavy in-memory database sorts.

title: Netflix Analytics Challenge — Gold Medal
tagline: 1st Place Gold Medal solution in Netflix Data Analytics Challenge, Open IIT 2026 (TSG, IIT Kharagpur)
metric: Ranked #1 Gold Medal out of 22 shortlisted halls across IIT Kharagpur
bullets: Secured 1st place GOLD medal in Netflix's Data Analytics Challenge, Open IIT 2026, conducted by Technology Students' Gymkhana (TSG).
Engineered machine learning pipelines with XGBoost and Scikit-Learn for user engagement forecasting and retention driver analysis.
Applied SHAP value explainability across multi-channel behavioral signals to uncover high-impact viewing patterns.
